blocks.text: Bachon, ab tak humne motion ko numbers aur formulas se samjha. Lekin aksar ek tasweer hazaar lafzon se behtar hoti hai. Is sabaq mein hum displacement-time graph parhna seekhenge: graph ko dekh kar foran bata dena ke particle chal raha hai ya ruka hua hai, aage ja raha hai ya peeche, tez hai ya aahista. Yeh hunar exam ke graph wale sawalon mein seedha kaam aata hai.
Kitab kehti hai: displacement-time graphs kinematics mein aham auzaar hain, kyun ke yeh kisi cheez ki motion ki tasweer pesh karte hain. Hum inhein is liye parhte hain:

items: Yeh saaf dikhate hain ke waqt ke saath cheez ki position kaise badalti hai.
In se aasaani se pata chalta hai ke cheez chal rahi hai, ruki hui hai, ya accelerate kar rahi hai.

blocks.text: Displacement-time graph mein displacement (\(x\)) \(y\)-axis (vertical) par, aur time (\(t\)) \(x\)-axis (horizontal) par lagaya jata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Haroof (letters) mein dhoka na khaiye: kinematics mein \(x\) displacement hai, lekin is graph par woh vertical axis par banta hai (jahan aam taur par \(y\) hota hai), aur time \(t\) horizontal axis par chalta hai. Graph ka har point \((t, x)\) batata hai ke waqt \(t\) par particle kahan tha.
Key Features of a Displacement-Time Graph
1. Graph ka slope \(= \left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)\), particle ki velocity ko dikhata hai.

Agar velocity uniform (ek jaisi) ho, yani
\[v = \dfrac{dx}{dt} = \text{Slope of the graph}\]
\[= \text{constant},\]
to displacement-time graph seedhi line hota hai.

items: Agar \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = 0\) ho, to particle rest mein (ruka hua) hai aur graph horizontal line hai, jo batati hai ke waqt ke saath displacement wahi rehta hai. Figure 7.1 mein particle point \(B\) se point \(C\) tak ruka hua hai.

Agar \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = \) constant \(> 0\) ho, to particle aage (forward) chalta hai, aur graph charhti hui (rising) seedhi line hai; yani waqt barhne ke saath displacement barhta hai. Figure 7.1 mein particle \(A\) se \(B\) tak positive uniform velocity se chal raha hai.

Agar \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = \) constant \(< 0\) ho, to particle ulti direction mein chalta hai, aur graph girti hui (falling) seedhi line hai; yani waqt barhne ke saath displacement ghatta hai. Figure 7.1 mein particle \(C\) se \(D\) tak uniform negative velocity se chal raha hai.

blocks.alt: Displacement-time graph with x on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis. A straight segment rises from A at the origin to B (labelled v), a horizontal segment runs from B to C (labelled v = 0), and a straight segment falls from C to D.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: displacement-time graph: rising from A to B, horizontal from B to C, falling from C to D (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Recall!
blocks.text:
Positive slope: forward motion (aage ki taraf).
Negative slope: backward motion (peeche ki taraf).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Slope hi velocity kyun hai? Graph ke do points ke beech slope \(= \frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}} = \frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}\), aur yeh bilkul average velocity hai (7.1.3 yaad kijiye). Seedhi line par yeh ratio har jagah ek jaisa hota hai, is liye velocity constant hoti hai. Agar graph curve (khamdaar) ho to velocity badalti rehti hai, aur kisi lamhe ki velocity us point par tangent ka slope, yani \(\frac{dx}{dt}\), hoti hai.
Graph jaldi parhne ka tareeqa: zyada dhalaan (steep) = zyada tez; horizontal = ruka hua; girta hua hissa = origin ki taraf wapas aa raha hai. Slope ki unit dono axes se banti hai: km per minute, m per second, waghaira.
Roz ki misaal: socho aap ghar se school ja rahe hain. Raaste mein dukaan par 5 minute ruke: graph ka woh hissa horizontal hoga. Phir bhaag kar gaye: woh hissa zyada dhalaan wala hoga. Chhutti ke baad wapas aaye: graph neeche girega.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pichle sabaq ki Example 1 ko graph par soch kar dekhiye, taa ke dono sabaq jud jayein. Aadmi 2 minute mein 100 m east chala: graph \((0, 0)\) se \((2, 100)\) tak charhti seedhi line, slope \(\frac{100}{2} = 50\) m/min. Phir 1 minute mein 60 m west: graph \((2, 100)\) se \((3, 40)\) tak girti seedhi line, slope \(\frac{40 - 100}{3 - 2} = -60\) m/min. Pehle hisse mein velocity \(+50\), doosre mein \(-60\): charhti line positive velocity, girti line negative velocity, bilkul Recall! box ke mutabiq.
Aur \((0, 0)\) se \((3, 40)\) tak seedhi line (chord) ka slope \(\frac{40}{3} \approx 13.33\) hai, jo wahi average velocity hai jo Example 1 mein nikli thi. Yaani graph par average velocity hamesha shuru aur aakhri point ko jodne wali line ka slope hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya displacement-time graph kabhi bilkul vertical (khari) line ho sakta hai? Nahin! Vertical line ka matlab hoga ke zero waqt mein particle ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunch gaya, yani infinite velocity. Asal motion mein yeh mumkin nahin. Isi liye graph par har \(t\) ke liye sirf ek \(x\) hota hai.
Ab do misaalein jin mein graph se seedha hisaab karna hai. Pehli mein cyclist ka safar hai, doosri mein Javed ka Murree ka safar.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph wale sawal ka pehla qadam hamesha ek hi hai: corner points (jahan line ka rukh badalta hai) ke coordinates parh kar likh lena. Figure 7.2 mein yeh chaar points hain: O, A, B aur C. Har point ka pehla number time hai (horizontal axis se) aur doosra number displacement (vertical axis se). Misaal ke taur par A ke neeche dekhein to time 20 minute hai, aur A ke baayen (left) dekhein to displacement 4 km hai, is liye \(A(20, 4)\).
Jab yeh points likh liye, to har hisse ke liye do ghataao (subtractions) karne hain: time ki tabdeeli aur displacement ki tabdeeli. Baaki sab formula ka kaam hai. Graph ko dekh kar andaze se jawab mat likhiye; har number graph se parh kar likhiye.

blocks.alt: Grid graph of displacement x in km (0 to 7) against t in minutes (0 to 70). Straight line from O(0, 0) up to A(20, 4), horizontal to B(50, 4), then straight down to C(60, 0).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: displacement-time graph of the cyclist's journey (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem:
A cyclist rides in a straight line for 20 minutes. He then stops and waits for 30 minutes, after which he returns in a straight line to the starting point in 10 minutes. Figure 7.2 shows the displacement-time graph for his journey.
(a) Calculate the average velocity for each stage of the journey in km/h.
(b) Calculate the average velocity for the whole journey.
(c) Find the average speed for the whole journey.
steps:
Diya gaya: Figure 7.2 ka graph, jis ke kone (corner points) yeh hain: \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(20, 4)\), \(B(50, 4)\), \(C(60, 0)\). Time minutes mein, displacement km mein.
Maloom karna: (a) OA, AB aur BC par alag alag average velocity km/h mein; (b) poore safar ki average velocity; (c) poore safar ki average speed.
Tareeqa: sab se pehle graph se har hisse (stage) ka time aur displacement ki tabdeeli parhenge. Phir average velocity = displacement / time lagayenge. Jawab km/h mein chahiye, is liye km/min ko 60 se multiply karenge (1 ghanta = 60 minute).
Ek baat pehle se zehan mein rakhiye: (a) aur (b) mein velocity maangi hai, is liye sign (plus ya minus) ka khayal rakhna hai; (c) mein speed maangi hai, is liye wahan distance lenge aur koi sign nahin hoga. Sawal ke har hisse se pehle yeh zaroor dekhiye ke velocity poochi ja rahi hai ya speed, kyun ke isi se formula badalta hai.

(a) O se A tak ka safar
Time = 20 minute, displacement = 4 km.
\[\text{Average velocity} = \dfrac{\text{Displacement}}{\text{Time}}\]
\[= \dfrac{4}{20} = \dfrac{1}{5}\ \text{km/min}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{5} \times 60 = 12\ \text{km/h}\]
Kyun: graph par \(x\) 0 se 4 tak gaya jab \(t\) 0 se 20 tak gaya. Ek minute mein jitna chala, ek ghante mein us ka 60 guna chalega.

A se B tak ka safar
Time = 30 minute, displacement = 0 km.
\[\text{Average velocity} = \dfrac{\text{Displacement}}{\text{Time}}\]
\[= \dfrac{0}{30} = 0\ \text{km/min}\]
\[= 0 \times 60 = 0\ \text{km/h}\]
\(\Rightarrow\) cyclist ruka hua (stationary) hai.
Kyun: AB horizontal line hai; \(x\) 4 km par hi raha, is liye displacement mein koi tabdeeli nahin. Yaad kijiye: displacement-time graph par horizontal line = rest.

B se C tak ka safar
Time = 10 minute, displacement = \(-4\) km.
\[\text{Average velocity} = \dfrac{\text{Displacement}}{\text{Time}}\]
\[= \dfrac{-4}{10} = -\dfrac{2}{5}\ \text{km/min}\]
\[= -\dfrac{2}{5} \times 60 = -24\ \text{km/h}\]
Kyun: \(x\) 4 se gir kar 0 par aaya, is liye tabdeeli \(0 - 4 = -4\) km hai. Minus sign batata hai ke cyclist wapas shuru wali jagah ki taraf ja raha hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan minus sign ko chhorna nahin. Velocity \(-24\) km/h hai; speed 24 km/h hogi.

(b) Poora safar
\[\text{Total displacement} = 4 + 0 + (-4) = 0\]
\[\text{Average velocity} = \dfrac{0}{60} = 0\]
Kyun: cyclist wahin wapas aa gaya jahan se chala tha (C time-axis par hai), is liye poore safar ka displacement 0 hai, aur average velocity bhi 0.

(c) Poore safar ki average speed
Total time = 60 minute = 1 ghanta; total distance = 4 + 4 = 8 km.
\[\text{Average speed} = \dfrac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}}\]
\[= \dfrac{8}{1}\ \text{km/h} = 8\ \text{km/h}\]
Kyun: distance mein jaane ke 4 km aur aane ke 4 km dono jama hote hain, baghair sign ke. Intezaar ka waqt bhi safar ka hissa hai, is liye kul time mein shamil hai.

Tasdeeq:
Har hisse ki velocity us segment ka slope hai: \(\frac{4}{20} > 0\), \(0\), \(\frac{-4}{10} < 0\), yani charhta, seedha aur girta segment; graph se bilkul match. Aur har hisse mein displacement = velocity \(\times\) time: \(12 \times \frac{20}{60} + 0 + (-24) \times \frac{10}{60} = 4 - 4 = 0\) km, jo (b) ke jawab se milta hai.
blocks.answer: (a) O se A: 12 km/h; A se B: 0 km/h (ruka hua); B se C: \(-24\) km/h. (b) 0 km/h. (c) 8 km/h.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 3 ke hal mein kitab ne teen dafa "Displacment" chhapa hai; sahi spelling "Displacement" hai (upar humne sahi likha hai). A se B wale hisse mein "\(0 \times 60 = 0\) km/h" se pehle ek faltu teer (arrow) ka nishan bhi chhapa hai; asal line sirf \(0 \times 60 = 0\) km/h hai. Jawabon par koi asar nahin.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar cyclist wapsi mein 10 ki bajaye 20 minute lagata, to wapsi ki velocity aur poore safar ki average speed kya hoti?
Wapsi ki velocity: \(\frac{-4}{20} = -\frac{1}{5}\) km/min \(= -12\) km/h. Graph par BC ki line kam dhalaan wali hoti.
Kul time ab \(20 + 30 + 20 = 70\) minute \(= \frac{7}{6}\) ghanta hai, aur distance phir bhi 8 km. Average speed \(= 8 \div \frac{7}{6} = \frac{48}{7} \approx 6.86\) km/h. Poore safar ki average velocity phir bhi 0, kyun ke woh wapas wahin aa gaya.

Ab Example 4. Is sawal mein ek nayi baat hai: graph par vertical axis ke number seedhe kilometre nahin batate, is liye humein pehle scale (paimana) nikaalna parta hai. Scale ka matlab hai "graph ka ek khana asal mein kitne km ke barabar hai". Jaise naqshe (map) par likha hota hai "1 cm = 10 km", waise hi yahan pehle safar ki maloom value se scale nikaalenge. Is se pehle kitab ki figure ki ek ghalti samajh lijiye.

blocks.alt: Grid graph of displacement in km (one square = 25 km, up to 150) against time in hours (0 to 5). Straight line from O(0, 0) up to A(2, 100), horizontal to B(3, 100), then up to C(4, 133.3).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.3: displacement-time graph of Javed's journey, drawn with the kilometre values the book's solution uses (original drawing after the textbook's figure; see the Book correction)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.3 mein vertical axis par 0 se 9 tak number likhe hain aur label "Displacement (km)" hai. Is hisaab se A 6 km par aur C 8 km par nazar aata hai. Yeh mumkin nahin: pehla safar 2 ghante 50 km/h par hai, yani 100 km, aur kitab ka apna hal bhi axis ko "6 units = 100 km" parhta hai. Matlab axis ke number grid ke units hain, kilometre nahin: A 100 km par hai aur C \(\frac{400}{3} \approx 133.3\) km par. Kitab ki figure mein label O bhi axis ki value 2 ke paas chhapa hai, halaanke O origin hai. Hamari drawing wohi kilometre values dikhati hai jo hal mein istemal hui hain.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem:
Javed drives from his home to Murree. He drives for 2 hours at an average velocity of 50 km/h. He then stops for lunch before continuing to Murree. Figure 7.3 shows a displacement-time graph for his journey.
(a) Work out the displacement of Murree from Javed's home.
(b) Work out his average velocity for his whole journey.
steps:
Diya gaya: pehla safar O se A: 2 ghante, average velocity 50 km/h; lunch ka waqfa A se B (\(t = 2\) se \(t = 3\) ghante); doosra safar B se C (\(t = 3\) se \(t = 4\) ghante), jaisa Figure 7.3 mein hai.
Maloom karna: (a) ghar (O) se Murree (C) ka displacement; (b) poore safar ki average velocity.
Tareeqa: pehle safar se A ka displacement nikalta hai (displacement = average velocity \(\times\) time). Yeh maloom value vertical axis ka scale bata deti hai, aur scale se B se C tak ki charhai (rise) nikal aati hai. Aakhir mein average velocity = kul displacement / kul time.

(a) O se A tak ka safar
Time = 2 ghante; average velocity = 50 km/h.
\[\text{average velocity} = \dfrac{\text{Displacement}}{\text{Time}}\]
\[50 = \dfrac{\text{Displacement}}{2}\]
\[\text{Displacement} = 50 \times 2 = 100\ \text{km}\]
Kyun: average velocity ki definition ko displacement ke liye hal kiya: dono taraf 2 se multiply.

Graph se vertical axis ka scale
\[6\ \text{units} = 100\ \text{km}\]
\[1\ \text{unit} = \dfrac{100}{6} = \dfrac{50}{3}\ \text{km}\]
Kyun: kitab ke chhape hue grid par A time-axis se 6 khane (units) upar hai, aur humne abhi nikala ke A par displacement 100 km hai. Is liye 6 khane = 100 km. (Upar "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye: chhapi hui axis par km likha hai magar number asal mein grid units hain. Hamari nayi Figure 7.3 mein values pehle hi km mein hain.)

B se C tak ka safar
\[\text{vertical rise} = 2\ \text{units}\]
\[\text{Displacement} = 2 \times \dfrac{50}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{100}{3}\ \text{km}\]
Kyun: chhape hue grid par C, B se 2 khane upar hai (8 aur 6), aur har khana \(\frac{50}{3}\) km ka hai.

Kul displacement
\[100 + \dfrac{100}{3} = \dfrac{400}{3}\]
\[\approx 133.3\ \text{km}\]
Kyun: lunch ke waqt kuch nahin juda (AB horizontal hai), is liye kul displacement = pehla safar + doosra safar. Yehi ghar se Murree ka displacement hai.

(b) Average velocity
Time = 2 ghante (pehla safar) + 1 ghanta (lunch) + 1 ghanta (doosra safar) = 4 ghante.
Total displacement = 133.3 km.
\[\text{Average velocity} = \dfrac{133.3}{4}\]
\[\approx 33.33\ \text{km/h}\]
Kyun: lunch ka ghanta bhi safar ka hissa hai, is liye kul time mein gina jata hai. Bilkul theek hisaab: \(\frac{400/3}{4} = \frac{100}{3} \approx 33.33\) km/h.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students lunch ka ghanta chhor kar 3 se divide kar dete hain; yeh ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq:
Nayi Figure 7.3 par C ka point \((4, 133.3)\) hai; average velocity O se C tak seedhi line (chord) ka slope hai: \(\frac{133.3 - 0}{4 - 0} \approx 33.33\). Yeh 50 km/h se kam hai, aur kam hi hona chahiye, kyun ke lunch ka ghanta (velocity 0) aur aahista doosra safar (1 ghante mein \(\frac{100}{3}\) km) average ko neeche le aate hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Javed ki doosre safar (B se C) mein velocity kitni thi, aur graph par yeh kaise nazar aata hai?
Velocity \(= \frac{100/3}{1} = \frac{100}{3} \approx 33.3\) km/h. Yeh pehle safar ki 50 km/h se kam hai, is liye BC ki line OA se kam dhalaan wali hai (graph mein bhi BC kam charhti hai). Shayad pahaari raaste ki wajah se gaari aahista chali! Dekha, graph ka slope seedha velocity bata deta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin.) Ab ek khamdaar (curved) graph dekhte hain. Maan lijiye \(x = t^{2}\) (meters, seconds). Is ka graph seedhi line nahin balke parabola ka hissa hai jo aage chal kar zyada dhalaan wala hota jata hai.
Velocity \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = 2t\). To \(t = 1\) par slope (velocity) 2 m/s hai, \(t = 3\) par 6 m/s. Graph jitna steep, particle utna tez: yaani yeh particle tez ho raha hai (accelerating).
\(t = 0\) se \(t = 3\) tak average velocity \(= \frac{9 - 0}{3 - 0} = 3\) m/s; yeh do points ko jodne wali chord ka slope hai. Dhyan dein ke average velocity (3) aur \(t = 3\) wali instantaneous velocity (6) mukhtalif hain, kyun ke velocity badal rahi thi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin.) Ek bachi ghar se seedhi sarak par 10 minute mein 1.2 km dukaan tak gayi, wahan 5 minute ruki, phir 15 minute mein 1.2 km wapas ghar aayi. Graph kaisa banega aur har hisse ki velocity kya hai?
Graph: pehle charhti line (0 se 1.2 km, 10 minute mein), phir horizontal line (5 minute), phir girti line (wapas 0 tak, 15 minute mein).
Velocities: jaate hue \(\frac{1.2}{10} = 0.12\) km/min \(= 7.2\) km/h; rukte hue 0; aate hue \(\frac{-1.2}{15} = -0.08\) km/min \(= -4.8\) km/h. Wapsi wali line kam dhalaan wali hogi, kyun ke wapsi aahista thi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Displacement \(x\) vertical axis par, time \(t\) horizontal axis par.
2. Displacement-time graph ka slope \(= \frac{dx}{dt} =\) velocity.
3. Seedhi line: uniform velocity. Charhti: \(v > 0\) (aage); horizontal: \(v = 0\) (ruka hua); girti: \(v < 0\) (peeche).
4. Kisi waqfe ki average velocity = \(x\) ki tabdeeli / \(t\) ki tabdeeli = do points ko jodne wali line (chord) ka slope.
5. Ruknay ka waqt bhi safar ke kul time mein gina jata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Girti hui line ko "aahista ho raha hai" samajhna. Girti hui seedhi line ka matlab constant negative velocity hai (wapas aa raha hai), speed kam hona nahin.
2. Horizontal line ko "constant speed se chal raha hai" samajhna. Displacement-time graph par horizontal ka matlab ruka hua hai. (Velocity-time graph par horizontal ka matlab alag hoga; woh agle sabaq 7.1.5 mein.)
3. Kul time nikaalte waqt rukne ka waqt chhor dena (Example 4 mein kul time 4 ghante hai, 3 nahin).
4. Units bhool jana: km ko minutes se divide karein to km/min aata hai; km/h ke liye 60 se multiply karein.
